snippet.title: Riftwalker - Action Trailer
snippet.description:
After 25+ years in design and game development, I’ve poured my passion into something personal: Riftwalker.

Riftwalker is a story-driven sci-fi action RPG where you play as Ashton Mercer, a bounty hunter who discovers the ability to cross into the Void, a strange and dangerous plane layered over reality. The Void is power, but it’s also a curse. Inside it lies the Plane of Echoes, where lost voices linger and universes bleed together.

This Patreon is where I’ll be sharing the journey: behind-the-scenes development, early gameplay previews, concept art, lore entries, and the raw, unfiltered progress that never makes it to social media. Supporting Riftwalker on Patreon helps bring this dream to life and gives you a direct role in shaping its future.

👉 Join the Riftwalker Patreon here: www.patreon.com/riftwalkergame

Thank you for supporting me on this journey. This is more than a game; it’s a world built from the ground up with love, experience, and a whole lot of passion.

- Ethan aka LuclinFTW
